reflection.noEmotions: Nothing to name here, and that is fine.

edit.limitReached: Four is as many as a card can hold
text.title: Say it in one sentence
saved.title: Saved
failure.title: That did not go through
notice.offlineBody: Your entry stays. Vidlun’s answer will come once you are back online.
delete.title: Delete this entry?

history.title: History
detail.fixHint: Recognition may have misheard. We will re-read what you fix.
stats.title: This week
milestone.hint: A milestone helps you see what came before and after.
stats.quietWeek: It’s still quiet this week. Your week appears here when there is something to read.
stats.proseLater: The narrative appears once the week has something to read — usually three or four entries.
stats.noNewWords: This month — the same words as before.
stats.refineLine: A precise word in {{n}} of {{m}} emotions this month.
stats.quietVocabulary: The vocabulary appears once you have named a few feelings in your own words.
dict.title: Your vocabulary
dict.purpose: How many different words you find for what you feel.
dict.noNewWordsPeriod: In this period — the same words as before.
dict.refineLinePeriod: A precise word in {{n}} of {{m}} emotions in this period.
dict.proseNew: In {{m}} this was simply “{{root}}”. Now it is {{list}} — different things, and you tell them apart.
dict.proseRefine: Instead of “{{from}}” it is now “{{to}}” — the same thing, more precisely.
stats.patternHigher: Entries with “{{tag}}” score higher. {{n}} {{times}} this month.
stats.patternLower: Entries with “{{tag}}” score lower. {{n}} {{times}} this month.
compare.noneCopy: No distinct emotion here — this sounded like an account of the day. That happens too.
compare.noneEcho: You said what you did, and almost nothing about how it was. Maybe that is enough for today.
feed.title: Journal
feed.emptyBody: Say how you are today, and the first card will appear here.
search.title: Search
search.nothingBody: Try another word or clear the emotion filter.
profile.title: Me
feedback.title: Write to us
feedback.body: Say it plainly — short is fine, no formalities. We read everything.
feedback.placeholder: What went wrong, or what is missing…
feedback.note: None of your entries are attached — only this text.
profile.audioOn: Recordings stay on this phone for thirteen months, then go. The written entry stays for good.
time.title: When to remind you
time.body: An evening hour when you are usually not going anywhere.
subs.name: Subscription or one-time purchase
subs.title: The weekly narrative
subs.body: Once a week Vidlun writes what it read in your entries: how the tone moved and what repeats. It is the only paid thing here.
subs.trialBody: The narrative is open. When the week ends we will say so plainly — what you already read stays yours.
subs.manageBody: Manage and cancel in the App Store. Everything you already read stays yours.
buy.errBody: The payment was declined or the connection dropped. Nothing was charged.
buy.noneBody: No Vidlun subscription was found on this Apple ID.
stats.patternNoneBody: Nothing repeating showed up this week. Patterns do not turn up every week — that is fine.
reminder.title: How was today?
settings.title: Settings
settings.keepRecordingsHint: Recordings stay on this phone for thirteen months, then go. The written entry stays for good.
settings.forgetBody: Every kept recording goes. The entries themselves stay.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Tell it how the day went. Vidlun does the rest.
onboarding.privacyOnDevice: The audio and text of your entries are stored on your phone.
onboarding.micBody: So you can just say it instead of typing it.
onboarding.legalNote: By tapping “Start” you agree to the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.
settings.themeHint: Matching the phone darkens with it in the evening. A chosen theme always stays.
processing.hint: Reading the words and finding ones for the mood. A few seconds.
processing.still: Still working. The connection is slow.
turn.question: Pick an emotion
turn.hidden: what Vidlun heard — after your answer
turn.skip: I don't know — just show me
diff.same: The same word. Vidlun has nothing to add.
diff.more: Vidlun also hears "{{word}}" — in your own words.
diff.missing: Vidlun did not hear "{{word}}". It is not in the words — but it was in you.
diff.other: Different words: "{{mine}}" and "{{theirs}}". Vidlun is not arguing.
diff.silent: No word came — that is an answer too. Vidlun leaves its own beside yours, not instead.
detail.disclaimer: Vidlun describes what was said. It gives no advice, verdicts or medical conclusions.
detail.audioGone: No audio kept — recordings are switched off in settings.
detail.audioMissing: No audio kept for this entry.
record.limitFree: A free recording runs up to a minute
subs.noteMonthly: Renews monthly at {{price}}. Cancel any time.
subs.noteAnnual: First {{n}} {{days}} free, then {{price}} per year. Cancel any time.
subs.noteLifetime: One payment of {{price}}. Nothing renews, nothing to cancel.
subs.storeQuietBody: Try again in a little while — nothing was charged.
settings.asksFirstOn: Vidlun asks you to pick an emotion, then shows what it heard.
settings.asksFirstOff: Vidlun shows what it heard right away.
stats.narrLockedLead: Vidlun has written about this week.
stats.trialLine: The weekly narrative lives in the subscription. The rest of Vidlun is free.
profile.backupHint: Save your entries to move them to another device. Audio does not come along.
profile.exportEmpty: Nothing to save yet — the journal is empty.
profile.restoreHint: For a new phone or after a reinstall: open the backup file and your entries come back to the journal.
profile.restoredBody: New entries: {{n}}. Already here and left as they were: {{skipped}}.
profile.restoredNothing: Everything in this file is already in the journal.
profile.importBadBody: It is not a Vidlun backup, or it was made by a newer version of the app.
profile.appLockOn: The journal opens with Face ID
profile.appLockUnavailableBody: This phone has no Face ID or passcode set up. Turn them on in iOS Settings first.
lock.title: The journal is locked
lock.body: This is your private place. It opens only to you.
ground.offer: Got a minute? You can stay with what’s around you.
ground.offerFact: None of it will be saved — no words, no voice.
ground.hint: Out loud or in a whisper. You can tap a circle instead of a word.
ground.endLine: All of it was right here.
ground.endFact: None of it is saved — no words, no voice, no entry in the journal.
stats.monthLockedLead: Vidlun has written about this month.
